description: This file contains a series of unit tests for the OpenClawChatViewModel, validating various behaviors such as message streaming, session management, model selection, and event handling in a chat application.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: A simple actor-based box to hold callback values for cross-actor communication.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: An actor acting as an asynchronous gate, allowing coordination by waiting and opening.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: An actor implementing a thread-safe counter, used to track attempts or requests.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: A class maintaining internal counters and logs for the mock chat transport's state during tests.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: A mock implementation of the OpenClawChatTransport protocol, simulating chat server responses and events for testing purposes.

methods.name: chatTextMessage
methods.description: Constructs a codable chat message with a role, text content, and timestamp.

methods.name: historyPayload
methods.description: Creates a chat history payload with optional session details and messages.

methods.name: sessionEntry
methods.description: Generates a chat session entry with specified key, timestamp, and optionally model details.

methods.name: modelChoice
methods.description: Builds a model choice object with an identifier, name, and provider.

methods.name: makeViewModel
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes a test chat view model, setting up mock responses and hooks.

methods.name: loadAndWaitBootstrap
methods.description: Loads the view model and waits until it is bootstrapped and ready.

methods.name: sendUserMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a user message via the view model.

methods.name: sendMessageAndEmitFinal
methods.description: Sends a user message, waits for a pending run, and emits a final response event.

methods.name: emitAssistantText
methods.description: Emits an assistant streaming text message event.

methods.name: emitExternalFinal
methods.description: Emits an external final chat event.
